notes.title: Plasmatic - Unveiling the Desktop Version!
notes.content:
🎉 Greetings, fellow Gamers! 🎉

We are thrilled to share some exhilarating news with you all. Our team has been hard at work developing the desktop version of our highly immersive game, Plasmatic! Brace yourselves for an unforgettable gaming experience on your PC. 💻🎮

For those who are new to Plasmatic, it is a virtual utopian space where society has willingly immersed itself. However, an unexpected awakening awaits players as they find themselves disconnected from this virtual paradise. The goal? Repair the main simulation core to restore the continuation of life within Plasmatic. But as you progress, doubts arise, and the true intentions of our AI guide, SPIRIT, become clearer. The question of whether the goal is righteous or not lingers in your mind, and the responsibility to shape the outcome falls solely upon you. 🌌🤔

Now, we are excited to expand the horizons of Plasmatic by bringing it to the desktop platform. With enhanced graphics, optimized performance, and intuitive controls, you will be fully immersed in this captivating world. The PC version will feature both mouse and keyboard support, allowing you to navigate and interact seamlessly. Furthermore, we have introduced a unique mouse control mode that enables you to detach the crosshair, adding an extra layer of freedom to your exploration. 🖱️⌨️✨

We value the opinions and feedback of our community, which is why we turn to you, the Redditors, to join us on this journey. As we develop the desktop version, we invite you to share your thoughts, suggestions, and expectations. Your input will play a vital role in shaping the final product and ensuring that Plasmatic becomes the ultimate gaming experience. 🗣️💡🔄

Stay tuned for further updates, sneak peeks, and exclusive behind-the-scenes content. Together, let us embark on this thrilling adventure and delve deeper into the mysteries of Plasmatic. ⚡️🔍

Thank you for your continued support! ❤️

EpicVR Team

notes.title: Plasmatic 1.9.2 Update
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes 1.9.2:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Introduced translations for Polish, German, French, Spanish, and Chinese, enabling a broader player base to enjoy the game.
[*] Improved texture quality for enhanced visual experience.
[*] Optimized RAM and VRAM usage by approximately 20%, resulting in smoother gameplay.
[*] Increased game performance through optimization efforts.
[*] Added Steam RichPresence feature, allowing you to share your achievements and current in-game status with other players.
[*] Enhanced font quality for better readability.
[*] Improved graphical settings, particularly the "Low" preset, which is now utilizing AMD FSR technology to enhance game smoothness on lower-end computers.
[*] Fixed the position of the elevator on levels 7 and 9 to prevent it from clipping into walls.
[/list]

notes.title: Plasmatic - Update v 1.9
notes.content:
[b]What's new in version 1.9?[/b]

- Updated game engine
- Updated the quality of many textures
- Updated lighting on Level 2
- Small graphical improvements
- Many "under the hood" bug fixes
- Added a warning on the monitor when SteamVR does not initialize correctly or does not detect any VR headset.

Many of the changes made are not visible, but they will allow us to introduce new and better content in future updates.

notes.title: Update 1.8.19
notes.content:
[h3]We've implemented some community-reported fixes in the latest update:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]New:[/b] There is a new Rotation Sensitivity Multiplier option (in Menu -> Options -> Gameplay).
[*] [b]Fix:[/b] We have fixed performance issues related to the Ultra and High settings.
[*] [b]Fix:[/b] Improved lighting at level 8.
[*] [b]Fix:[/b] From now on, on failure, the screen first dims and then reloads the level - protects against a sudden and disruptive drop in game performance.
[*] [b]Adjustment:[/b] The elapsed time reminder now starts at the last 1m 30s, up from 30s.
[/list]

notes.title: What's new in full release?
notes.content:
What's the differences between demo and full release:
- Optimization for Oculus Quest users
- Default quality settings are now on medium
- Rotation Settings available (after steam discussion feedback - thank you guys <3)
- Lights are now more visible after filling the whole battery
- New Easter Egg lines from SPIRIT
- New collision sounds
- New time ending feature (Now lights and music are changing in the last seconds of current level, to increase the tension associated with the time running out)
- high and ultra settings fix
